capabilities: Convert copied NotebookLM mindmap code into .canvas files
Parse mindmap data in JSON or Markdown format
Lay out the tree left-to-right, right-to-left, or symmetrically
Pre-configure edge styles (arrowheads, path types, line patterns) for Advanced Canvas
Open the generated canvas automatically after creation
extras: Installable via BRAT; the conversion depends on data copied out of NotebookLM by a separate Chrome extension, so no direct NotebookLM connection exists.
intentEvidence: Full support for Advanced Canvas styling
problem: NotebookLM mindmaps cannot be exported into Obsidian's Canvas format, so they had to be rebuilt by hand as canvas boards.

relations.evidence: you need to use the NotebookLM Ultra Exporter Chrome Extension (or a similar tool) to copy the mindmap code

summary: Converts NotebookLM mindmaps copied as JSON or Markdown into Obsidian Canvas files, with layout direction and edge styling options.
